title: AI model proposes quaternary ammonium disinfectant structures with micromolar activity
summary: An AI/machine-learning model using antimicrobial data and synthetic insight generated novel quaternary ammonium compound structures grouped into clusters. Twenty exemplars of one cluster were prepared; Pyr-11(4)12, Pyr-12(4)12 and Pyr-10(4)14 showed single-digit micromolar MIC values across an eight-strain panel of Gram-positive, Gram-negative and resistant bacteria.
ai_technology: AI/machine-learning generative model for quaternary ammonium compound structures

evidence.tested: Synthesis of 20 exemplars and MIC assays against an eight-bacteria panel.
evidence.unknown: In vitro activity only; model details and toxicity not reviewed; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: The model generated the novel QAC structure clusters from which exemplars were synthesised.
